description.en: The city. The default value is Hangzhou.
The common name of the certificate.
The country. The default value is CN.
The name of the organization. The default value is Alibaba Inc.
The name of the department. The default value is Aliyun CDN.

description.zh: 证书扩展字段，绑定的域名，多个域名用逗号（,）分隔。
description.en: The Subject Alternative Names (SANs) for the certificate. These are the domain names that are bound to the certificate. Use a comma (,) to separate multiple domain names.
The province or state. The default value is Zhejiang.

title.zh: 创建证书签名请求文件

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dcdn create-dcdn-certificate-signing-request --common-name example.com --sa-ns example.com,example.org --organization Alibaba_Inc --organization-unit Aliyun_CDN --country CN --state Zhejiang --city Hangzhou --email username@example.com --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun dcdn CreateDcdnCertificateSigningRequest --region cn-hangzhou --Organization Alibaba_Inc --Email 'username@example.com' --SANs 'example.com,example.org' --OrganizationUnit Aliyun_CDN --State Zhejiang --Country CN --City Hangzhou --CommonName 'example.com'
